intent: Individually teach under a parked car, a check-before-arrival instruction, contextual bat with both hands, light enough for beginners, still-wet tennis court without inferred rain, players crossing together, own-lane instruction and lights on before sunset. Four changing diagrams, two order tasks, one evidence task and an original equipment picture; source translations need narrow repairs at future claim.

picturePurpose: An original bat/racket picture makes equipment identification a two-target task; grip details remain in code. Four changing diagrams teach relative ball position, wet versus dry without inferred weather, crossing together and own-lane requirements. Two timelines and exact evidence selections preserve order and weight/learner scope.
